ContrastTest.LightBytesHint.zh-CN: 先刻录对比度测试盘，再选出比两侧 AA 圈更亮的圈号。仅用于音轨，并使用 2 级影调。
ContrastTest.LightBytesHint.en: Burn the contrast test disc first, then pick the band that looks brighter than the AA bands beside it. Audio tracks only; uses 2 tone levels.

ContrastTest.BurnTestDisc.zh-CN: 改为刻录对比度测试盘（不写入图片）
ContrastTest.BurnTestDisc.en: Burn the contrast test disc instead of the picture

ContrastTest.BurnTestDiscHint.zh-CN: 测试盘按本工程的盘片参数写入 6 圈编号的浅色候选字节，每圈两侧是标准 AA 圈，最内圈是标准深色 0D。请用与正式刻录相同的速度刻录。
ContrastTest.BurnTestDiscHint.en: Writes six numbered light-byte candidates for this project's disc, each between standard AA bands, with the standard dark 0D at the hub. Burn it at the speed you will use for the real disc.

对比度测试盘 · 浅色字节.zh-CN: 对比度测试盘 · 浅色字节

\n刻录后在设计页「影调」中选出比两侧 AA 圈更亮的圈号。.zh-CN: 刻录后在设计页「影调」中选出比两侧 AA 圈更亮的圈号。
\n刻录后在设计页「影调」中选出比两侧 AA 圈更亮的圈号。.en: After burning, pick the band that looks brighter than the AA bands beside it under Tone on the Design page.
